issues.detail: All claim-level dependencies are empty, so the KZ-to-vortex, vortex-to-incompressible-energy, and annihilation-to-phonon-to-compressible-energy derivations are not represented.
The card omits the two total-incompressible-energy fits at normalized-source lines 418-420, so it cannot author the intended two-readout temperature-regime family.
The paper reports temperature at 1 and 1e-6 as two regimes; the card incorrectly exposes the entire interval as a continuous control.
The low-temperature claim cites a fixed-condition bundle that explicitly sets temperature to 1.
The card combines crossing-relative equilibration delay with the absolute-time expression containing the linear crossing-time term.
A source proportionality for vortex density is represented as an equality with an absolute normalization.
Several fit uncertainties are assigned an interpretation not stated by the source, while standard deviation, confidence interval, and ODR standard-error conventions are conflated.
Several readout locators support captions or fits but not the asserted operational definitions.
The quench-time domain stated for vortex scaling is propagated to other energy and equilibration claims without claim-specific source support.
